steps.en: Install dependencies and put a Firecrawl key and an LLM key in .env.local
steps.zh: 装好依赖，Firecrawl 与 LLM key 写进 .env.local

steps.en: Start it, type the question, and pick breadth and depth
steps.zh: 启动后输入问题，选好广度和深度

steps.en: Asks follow-up questions to pin down what you actually want
steps.zh: 反问几个追问，弄清你到底想要什么

steps.en: Generates search queries, scrapes the hits via Firecrawl, extracts learnings and next directions
steps.zh: 生成搜索词，经 Firecrawl 抓取结果，提炼要点和下一步方向

steps.en: While depth remains, recurses on the new directions, carrying the learnings so far
steps.zh: 深度没用完就带着已有要点沿新方向递归

steps.en: Writes all learnings and their source URLs into a Markdown report
steps.zh: 把所有要点和来源链接写成一份 Markdown 报告

value.en: A question becomes a sourced report through a loop short enough to read in one sitting and fork
value.zh: 一个问题变成一份带出处的报告，而背后的循环短到一口气就能读完、拿去改

sources: https://github.com/dzhng/deep-research README "Setup" (npm install; .env.local with FIRECRAWL_KEY, OPENAI_KEY)
https://github.com/dzhng/deep-research README "Usage" (npm start; prompts for query, breadth, depth, follow-up questions; report saved as report.md or answer.md)
https://github.com/dzhng/deep-research README "How It Works" (SERP queries, learnings, directions, recurse while depth > 0, markdown report with sources)
